interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your most memorable travel experience?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: What do you think is the importance of travel in life?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about pet care.
questions: Q1: Have you ever owned a pet? What was it like?
Q2: What are some common challenges of taking care of pets?
Q3: In your opinion, what makes a pet a good companion?
Q4: What tips would you give to new pet owners?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
